Trigger trigger_actor
    WhenToTest CharacterTurnEndInSettlement
    Condition IsGeneral
          and RemainingMPPercentage = 100
          and SettlementBuildingExists >= town_theatre
          and Trait DramasFanGreekVice > 0

    AcquireAncillary actor_greek chance  1

;------------------------------------------

    WhenToTest CharacterComesOfAge
    Condition FatherTrait LoyaltyLevel >= 6

    AcquireAncillary aged_retainer chance  20

          and IsGeneral

          and I_TurnNumber <=  180
          and not CultureType barbarian
        and not CultureType celtiberian

        and not CultureType dacian
        and not CultureType thracian
        and not CultureType scythian
          and Trait Superstitious >= 1

    AcquireAncillary appolonius_of_perge chance  20
